part.text:
Implemented the fix in `include/fmt/core.h:2239`.

The `0` flag now only sets numeric alignment and zero fill when no explicit alignment was provided, so it is ignored when combined with `<`, `>`, or `^`.

All 20 test suites pass, including `format_test.zero_flag_and_align`.
